title: Companies
subtitle: View every company (tenant) on the platform and create new ones.

dialog.title: Create a new company
dialog.slugHint: Used on the sign-in screen. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; 3-40 characters.
dialog.ownerMode: How should the sign-in details be provided?
dialog.modeInviteHint: The owner sets their own password from the emailed link; you never see it.
dialog.modePasswordHint: The account is activated right away with the password you set. You need to pass the password to the owner separately.

created.invited: Company created. An invitation email was sent to the owner.
created.withPassword: Company created. The owner can sign in with the password you set.
